<h1 id="gpt-4o-transcribe">GPT-4o Transcribe</h1>

<p><code>openai/gpt-4o-transcribe</code></p>

A speech-to-text model that uses GPT-4o to transcribe audio with improved word error rate and better language recognition compared to original Whisper models.

<div class="table-scroll"><table><tbody>
<tr><th>Task</th><td>Automatic Speech Recognition</td></tr>
<tr><th>Terms</th><td><a href="https://openai.com/policies/">Model terms</a></td></tr>
<tr><th>Unit pricing</th><td>Per audio minute: 0.006</td></tr>
</tbody></table></div>

<h2 id="usage">Usage</h2>

Transcribe an audio file with default settings

<section class="model-example"><strong>Basic Transcription</strong>
<p>Transcribe an audio file with default settings</p>
<pre><code class="language-json">{
  &quot;input&quot;: {
    &quot;file&quot;: &quot;data:audio/wav;base64,&quot;
  },
  &quot;output&quot;: {
    &quot;text&quot;: &quot;Hello&quot;
  },
  &quot;raw_response&quot;: {
    &quot;gatewayMetadata&quot;: {
      &quot;keySource&quot;: &quot;Unified&quot;
    },
    &quot;result&quot;: {
      &quot;text&quot;: &quot;Hello&quot;
    },
    &quot;state&quot;: &quot;Completed&quot;
  }
}</code></pre>
<pre><code class="language-typescript">const response = await env.AI.run(
  &#x27;openai/gpt-4o-transcribe&#x27;,
  { file: &#x27;data:audio/wav;base64,&lt;...&gt;&#x27; },
)
console.log(response)</code></pre>
<pre><code class="language-bash">curl https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/$CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID/ai/run \
  --header &quot;Authorization: Bearer $CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN&quot; \
  --header &quot;Content-Type: application/json&quot; \
  --data &#x27;{
  &quot;model&quot;: &quot;openai/gpt-4o-transcribe&quot;,
  &quot;input&quot;: {
    &quot;file&quot;: &quot;data:audio/wav;base64,&lt;...&gt;&quot;
  }
}&#x27;</code></pre>
</section>

<h2 id="examples">Examples</h2>

<section class="model-example"><strong>With Language Hint</strong>
<p>Transcribe with a language hint for better accuracy</p>
<pre><code class="language-json">{
  &quot;input&quot;: {
    &quot;file&quot;: &quot;data:audio/wav;base64,&quot;,
    &quot;language&quot;: &quot;en&quot;
  },
  &quot;output&quot;: {
    &quot;text&quot;: &quot;Hello&quot;
  },
  &quot;raw_response&quot;: {
    &quot;gatewayMetadata&quot;: {
      &quot;keySource&quot;: &quot;Unified&quot;
    },
    &quot;result&quot;: {
      &quot;text&quot;: &quot;Hello&quot;
    },
    &quot;state&quot;: &quot;Completed&quot;
  }
}</code></pre>
<pre><code class="language-typescript">const response = await env.AI.run(
  &#x27;openai/gpt-4o-transcribe&#x27;,
  { file: &#x27;data:audio/wav;base64,&lt;...&gt;&#x27;, language: &#x27;en&#x27; },
)
console.log(response)</code></pre>
<pre><code class="language-bash">curl https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/$CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID/ai/run \
  --header &quot;Authorization: Bearer $CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN&quot; \
  --header &quot;Content-Type: application/json&quot; \
  --data &#x27;{
  &quot;model&quot;: &quot;openai/gpt-4o-transcribe&quot;,
  &quot;input&quot;: {
    &quot;file&quot;: &quot;data:audio/wav;base64,&lt;...&gt;&quot;,
    &quot;language&quot;: &quot;en&quot;
  }
}&#x27;</code></pre>
</section>

<section class="model-example"><strong>Guided Transcription</strong>
<p>Use a prompt to guide transcription style and context</p>
<pre><code class="language-json">{
  &quot;input&quot;: {
    &quot;file&quot;: &quot;data:audio/wav;base64,&quot;,
    &quot;prompt&quot;: &quot;This is a technical discussion about Kubernetes and cloud-native architecture.&quot;,
    &quot;language&quot;: &quot;en&quot;
  },
  &quot;output&quot;: {
    &quot;text&quot;: &quot;This is a technical discussion about Kubernetes and cloud-native architecture.&quot;
  },
  &quot;raw_response&quot;: {
    &quot;gatewayMetadata&quot;: {
      &quot;keySource&quot;: &quot;Unified&quot;
    },
    &quot;result&quot;: {
      &quot;text&quot;: &quot;This is a technical discussion about Kubernetes and cloud-native architecture.&quot;
    },
    &quot;state&quot;: &quot;Completed&quot;
  }
}</code></pre>
<pre><code class="language-typescript">const response = await env.AI.run(
  &#x27;openai/gpt-4o-transcribe&#x27;,
  {
    file: &#x27;data:audio/wav;base64,&lt;...&gt;&#x27;,
    prompt: &#x27;This is a technical discussion about Kubernetes and cloud-native architecture.&#x27;,
    language: &#x27;en&#x27;,
  },
)
console.log(response)</code></pre>
<pre><code class="language-bash">curl https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/$CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID/ai/run \
  --header &quot;Authorization: Bearer $CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN&quot; \
  --header &quot;Content-Type: application/json&quot; \
  --data &#x27;{
  &quot;model&quot;: &quot;openai/gpt-4o-transcribe&quot;,
  &quot;input&quot;: {
    &quot;file&quot;: &quot;data:audio/wav;base64,&lt;...&gt;&quot;,
    &quot;prompt&quot;: &quot;This is a technical discussion about Kubernetes and cloud-native architecture.&quot;,
    &quot;language&quot;: &quot;en&quot;
  }
}&#x27;</code></pre>
</section>

<section class="model-example"><strong>High Temperature</strong>
<p>Higher temperature for more varied transcription</p>
<pre><code class="language-json">{
  &quot;input&quot;: {
    &quot;file&quot;: &quot;data:audio/wav;base64,&quot;,
    &quot;temperature&quot;: 0.5
  },
  &quot;output&quot;: {
    &quot;text&quot;: &quot;Hello, world!&quot;
  },
  &quot;raw_response&quot;: {
    &quot;gatewayMetadata&quot;: {
      &quot;keySource&quot;: &quot;Unified&quot;
    },
    &quot;result&quot;: {
      &quot;text&quot;: &quot;Hello, world!&quot;
    },
    &quot;state&quot;: &quot;Completed&quot;
  }
}</code></pre>
<pre><code class="language-typescript">const response = await env.AI.run(
  &#x27;openai/gpt-4o-transcribe&#x27;,
  { file: &#x27;data:audio/wav;base64,&lt;...&gt;&#x27;, temperature: 0.5 },
)
console.log(response)</code></pre>
<pre><code class="language-bash">curl https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/$CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID/ai/run \
  --header &quot;Authorization: Bearer $CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN&quot; \
  --header &quot;Content-Type: application/json&quot; \
  --data &#x27;{
  &quot;model&quot;: &quot;openai/gpt-4o-transcribe&quot;,
  &quot;input&quot;: {
    &quot;file&quot;: &quot;data:audio/wav;base64,&lt;...&gt;&quot;,
    &quot;temperature&quot;: 0.5
  }
}&#x27;</code></pre>
</section>

<h2 id="parameters">Parameters</h2>

<h3 id="input">Input</h3>

<div class="table-scroll"><table><thead><tr><th>Name</th><th>Type</th><th>Description</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td><code>file</code></td><td>string</td><td>Required. The audio file as a data URI (data:audio/...;base64,...) or HTTPS URL. Supported formats: flac, mp3, mp4, mpeg, mpga, m4a, ogg, wav, webm.</td></tr><tr><td><code>language</code></td><td>string</td><td>The language of the input audio. Supplying the input language in ISO-639-1 format will improve accuracy and latency.</td></tr><tr><td><code>prompt</code></td><td>string</td><td>An optional text to guide the model's style or continue a previous audio segment. The prompt should match the audio language.</td></tr><tr><td><code>temperature</code></td><td>number</td><td>The sampling temperature, between 0 and 1. Higher values like 0.8 will make the output more random, while lower values like 0.2 will make it more focused and deterministic. Defaults to 0 if omitted. Minimum: 0; Maximum: 1</td></tr></tbody></table></div>

<h3 id="output">Output</h3>

<div class="table-scroll"><table><thead><tr><th>Name</th><th>Type</th><th>Description</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td><code>text</code></td><td>string</td><td>Required. The transcribed text.</td></tr></tbody></table></div>
